P.name: Rage Gene
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Rage Gene:}} {{ci|Gnar|Mini Gnar}} generates {{pp|4;7;11|1 to 11}} ''{{ai|Rage Gene|Gnar|Rage}}'' over 2 seconds upon dealing or receiving damage, up to 100. Against non-champions, {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Boomerang Throw|Gnar}}'' instantly generate{{ft|{{pp|4*0.125;7*0.125;11*0.125|1 to 11|round=false}} ''Rage''.|{{fd|12.5%}} of the amount.}} Against champions, ''{{ai|Boomerang Throw|Gnar}}'' instantly generates{{ft|{{pp|4*0.25;7*0.25;11*0.25|1 to 11|round=false}} ''Rage'',|25% of the amount,}}and basic attacks ''on-hit'' instantly generate{{ft|{{pp|4*0.5;7*0.5;11*0.5|1 to 11|round=false}}.|50% of the amount.}}''{{ai|Boomerang Throw|Gnar}}'' can only generate ''Rage'' once per cast, and grants ''Rage'' based on the first enemy hit. '''Gnar's''' ''Rage'' decays after being [[combat status|out of combat]] for 13 seconds.
P.description2: At maximum ''Rage'', '''Gnar's''' {{tip|abilities}} switch to {{cis|Mega Gnar}} abilities, for 4 seconds and until transforming back to his ''Mini Gnar'' form, with the exception of ''{{ai|Hop and Crunch|Gnar|Hop}}'', which switches after the transformation. Casting any of them during this time also causes '''Gnar''' to transform into {{ci|Mega Gnar}} instantly, else he will transform automatically after the 4 seconds have elapsed.
P.description3: '''Gnar's''' {{ci|Mega Gnar|Mega}} form lasts for 15 seconds, with his ''Rage'' bar depleting as an indication of remaining time. ''Rage cannot be generated while in this form.'' Afterwards, '''Gnar''' returns to {{ci|Gnar|Mini Gnar}}, retaining his {{sti|health|{{as|'''current''' percentage health}}}} and becoming too [[File:Rage Gene 4.png|20px]] ''tired'' to generate ''Rage'' for 15 seconds.
P.description4: '''Gnar''' gains different stat bonuses based on whether he is in ''{{ai|Mini Gnar|Gnar|Mini}}'' or ''{{ai|Mega Gnar|Gnar|Mega}}'' form. Both of '''Gnar's''' forms share their ability cooldowns.

Q.name: Boulder Toss
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gnar''' throws a boulder in the target direction that stops upon hitting an enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies upon impact and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 2 seconds. The boulder then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.
Q.description2: After {{fd|0.3}} seconds, '''Gnar''' can pick up the boulder by moving within 90 units of it, refunding 70% of the ability's {{sti|cooldown|'''total''' cooldown}}.

W.name: Wallop
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gnar''' slams his arm down in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to all enemies struck within the area and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|1.25}} seconds.

E.name: Crunch
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gnar''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location and deals {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies upon impact and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 80% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. After a {{fd|0.25}}-second delay, '''Gnar''' sends out a shockwave, dealing the same damage to additional enemies in a larger radius.

R.name: GNAR!
R.description: {{sbc|{{ci|Gnar|Mini Gnar}} - Passive:}} ''{{ais|Hyper|Gnar}}'' {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} is increased.
R.description2: {{sbc|{{ci|Mega Gnar}} - Active:}} '''Gnar''' thrusts in the target direction, {{tip|airborne|knocking away}} nearby enemies up to 590 units in that direction, though not through terrain, and afterwards dealing them {{as|physical damage}}, as well as {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 45% after a {{fd|0.4}}-second delay for a duration.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|200 to 400}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}
{{st|Disable Duration|{{ap|1.25 to 1.75}}}}
R.description3: Enemies that collide with terrain take {{ccs|50% increased damage|physical}} immediately and are {{tip|stun|stunned}} instantly instead of {{tip|slow|slowed}} after a delay.
